name: OH Salad Open 2025

information:
**Español** Nos complace anunciar esta competencia de speedcubing en el local OH Salad, esperamos  que este sea un evento emocionante para competidores, familia y amigos. Los esperamos ansiosos!!!

**English** We are pleased to announce this speedcubing competition at the OH Salad food shop. We hope to make this an exciting event for competitors, family, and friends. We look forward to seeing you there!
